newsitem.title: USA: Avid stock jumps on strong earnings.
newsitem.headline: Avid stock jumps on strong earnings.

text.p: The stock of Avid Technology gained nearly 27 percent Thursday after the maker of digital video and audio editing systems reported better-than-expected results for the latest quarter.
In heavy trading of more than 2.5 million shares -- five times its normal trading volume -- Avid jumped $4.25 to $19.25 on the Nasdaq.
On Wednesday, the Tewksbury, Mass.-based company posted first-quarter earnings of $1.79 million, or 8 cents a share, compared with a loss of $22.8 million, or $1.08 a share a year earlier.
Analysts expected Avid to lose 9 cents a share, with some forecasting a loss of up to 17 cents a share, according to First Call.

"Their numbers were obviously better than expected," said Edgar Bierdeman, an analyst with Dakin Securities. "The gross margins were higher than expected, and the company controlled operating expenses better than expected."
He added that, "the second quarter could be better, as well, given the expense control we've seen."
